name: Ultras

features.name: 100 lines
features.description: A classic layout with football flavour.

features.name: Expanding wilds
features.description: Wilds on reels 2–4 expand to fill the reel.

review:
A 100-line football-fan game, with red and blue flares in the stands. Expanding wilds on reels 2, 3 and 4 cover everything except scatters and bonus symbols.

The Hold and Win tracks your progress with stars as you collect bonus symbols, and Chance x2 doubles your bonus odds. Medium-low volatility, 5,000x max and 97% RTP, with the bonus about once every 119 spins. Same base as Hot Chilli Bells 100.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 119 spins on average)
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
